profile.grounding_note: Simulated coaching profile grounded in real StudentLife pre-term surveys (PSS=21.0, PHQ-9=13.0, UCLA Loneliness=32.0, PHQ-9 item 9=0, Extraversion=2.12, Neuroticism=3.5, Conscientiousness=4.22); courses: COSC 077, COSC 065.
goals: Protect sleep (>=7 hours) ahead of COSC 065 and COSC 077 deadlines
Use structured task chunking and brief pauses when pre-deadline stress rises
Avoid notification fatigue on calm, well-rested days

preferences.activity_style: Short walks, quiet study breaks, and structured 30-minute task blocks
dislikes: interruptions when stress is low and sleep is >7.5h

constraints: Elevated pre-term PHQ-9 (13.0) and PSS (21.0) with low extraversion (2.12)
